lead.label: RP-6306 (lunresertib)
lead.why: Title/abstract: process development of 'an efficient, robust, and scalable synthetic route that allows the rapid production of large quantities of lunresertib drug substance (RP-6306)'; it is the paper's target API.

reactions.conditions: 4 (1 equiv), 3 (1.1 equiv), Cs2CO3 (2 equiv), XantPhos (0.06 equiv), Pd(OAc)2 (0.02 equiv), DME, 85 C, 20 h; precipitated with water, reslurried in EtOH; 82 %.
Malononitrile (1.2 equiv), NaOtBu (1.5 equiv), DME; then 5, dppf (0.02 equiv), Pd(dppf)Cl2.CH2Cl2 (0.02 equiv), 85 C, 22 h; 74 % of racemic 2.

One pot: MsOH containing a controlled amount of water, 44 C, 8 h (nitrile hydration to the primary amide); then DL-methionine (4 equiv), 75 C, 20 h (O-demethylation); quench into water, pH 7-9 with NaOH, THF reslurry (crude 100 %), recrystallisation from MeOH/water (76 %). In the paper this is done on the resolved (S)-2 (1R)-camphorsulfonate 8, giving (S)-RP-6306; the resolution is a separation, so the reference target is the racemate.
reactions.source: Experimental section, p.1683; text p.1682 (one-pot hydration/demethylation); medicinal chemistry route to racemate 7 in the Results text p.1677

alt_variants.conditions: MsOH/water, 40-44 C, 1 h (initial two-step process, Scheme 5 text, p.1682; medicinal chemistry route used H2SO4/MsOH).

notes: Lead is the (S)-atropisomer RP-6306, obtained from racemic 2 only by classical resolution ((R)-CSA salt 8, anisole) plus recrystallisation, so per the brief the target is the racemate (no stereo in the SMILES; atropisomer axis unspecified). Resolution/recrystallisation steps are separations and not counted. Name of the racemate is the printed RP-6306 name with '(S)-' dropped. Experimental text labels the product of step 1 as '3' at the end of its procedure ('afford 3 as a yellow solid'), a typo for 5. Compounds 3 and 4 are used as received with no preparation (treated as commercial; the paper does not state a supplier). The 3 steps in the main route are the paper's process steps; alt_variant is the earlier non-telescoped two-step hydration then demethylation (4 steps). Authors' Scheme 2 (medicinal chemistry route) gives the same racemate via 6 then 7.
